name: Clipboard History
description:
Keeps a searchable history of what you copy, and pastes an entry back where you were typing when you click it. Screenshots and other images are listed too, with a thumbnail.

* Reads the clipboard to record new copies, and to paste the entry you click
* Writes to the clipboard only when you click an entry
* Clicking an entry sends a Ctrl+V keystroke to the window you were typing in
* Stores history and images under ~/.local/share/clipboard-manager/ and never accesses the network

Pairs with the optional clipman GTK app, which reads the same history file.
